items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I went to back to Australia about three more times with Duke Ellington... I was in the band about six weeks

ctx.x: That’s wild. How did the thing with Ray Charles come about?

Let’s see. I don’t really remember. I think I was playing up at Minton’s in New York. Oh no, I remember now, somebody recommended me to Ray. And he was going to Australia. So I’d never been to Australia before, so I took it, just on that. And I went to back to Australia about three more times with Duke Ellington.
Was the Ray Charles Orchestra a fun group to play with?
